zh.title: 空中巴士第二季交付237架飛機 並維持全年870架目標
zh.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年第二季共交付237架飛機。空中巴士同時維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。報導指出，維持永續的產能提升，對空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標將是關鍵要素。
body: 根據新聞媒體Simple Flying報導，空中巴士在2026年第二季度總共完成了237架飛機的交付作業。
在公布第二季度的交付數據之際，空中巴士依然保持全年總計交付870架飛機的既定目標。
Simple Flying報導分析，空中巴士能否維持永續的產能提升步調，對於其能否順利實現全年度870架飛機的交付目標而言至為關鍵。
保持永續的生產提速步調，將是空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標的要務。

en.title: Airbus Delivers 237 Aircraft In Q2, Maintains Full-Year Target Of 870
en.summary: According to a report published by Simple Flying on July 29, 2026, Airbus achieved 237 aircraft deliveries during the second quarter. In addition to these delivery results, Airbus is keeping its target of 870 deliveries for the full year. Simple Flying reported that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be crucial in order for Airbus to achieve its 870-aircraft delivery target for the full year.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, Airbus achieved a total of 237 aircraft deliveries in the second quarter of 2026.
Along with the second-quarter delivery figures, Airbus confirmed that it is keeping its full-year target of 870 aircraft deliveries.
Simple Flying highlighted that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be a crucial factor for Airbus as it seeks to achieve its delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year.
The delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year remains the focus as Airbus works to maintain its sustainable production ramp-up.

zh.title: 波音737 MAX 10完成最後認證試飛 朝2026取證再邁一步
zh.summary: 波音宣布737 MAX 10已完成所有規劃的認證飛行測試，累計近千架次飛行、超過2,000小時。公司仍以2026年取得FAA認證、2027年開始交付為目標，同時737 MAX 7認證文件進度約95%。
body: 波音公司（Boeing）在7月底宣布，737 MAX 10已完成所有規劃的認證飛行測試，為這款多次延遲的最大737 MAX家族成員清除一項關鍵技術障礙。最後一次試飛從西雅圖波音機場（Boeing Field）起降，測試機組人員是否能清楚聽到洗手間煙霧探測器與客艙揚聲器系統的警示聲。
根據波音說法，MAX 10試飛機隊由三架飛機組成，累計完成976次飛行、超過2,060小時，並進行約1,040小時地面測試。測試範圍涵蓋主起落架、濕跑道煞車性能與最大能量中斷等項目，也驗證了引擎防冰系統與攻角感測器的修改。
波音737開發計畫副總裁暨總經理Chris Payne表示，達成這項里程碑是整個團隊承諾與投入的體現，也是邁向未來的重要一步。接下來波音仍需完成剩餘安全審查與設計評估，並向聯邦航空總署（FAA）遞交最終文件。
第三階段開發確保審查已結束，第四階段完成約60%，系統安全評估進度約32%。波音持續以2026年取得認證、2027年啟動首批客戶交付為目標。執行長Kelly Ortberg在第二季財報電話會議上也確認，兩款新機型可望2027年投入服役。
較小的737 MAX 7同樣完成飛行測試，波音指出其認證文件進度約95%。西南航空（Southwest Airlines）握有256架MAX 7確定訂單，聯合航空（United Airlines）則以167架訂單成為MAX 10最大客戶。目前現役的MAX 8與MAX 9均已獲認證並交付營運。

en.title: Boeing 737 MAX 10 wraps final certification flight testing, targets FAA nod in 2026
en.summary: Boeing has completed planned certification flight testing of the 737 MAX 10, logging nearly 1,000 flights and more than 2,000 hours. The manufacturer continues to target FAA certification in 2026 and first customer deliveries in 2027, while MAX 7 certification documentation is roughly 95% complete.
body: Boeing announced in late July that the 737 MAX 10 had completed its planned certification flight testing, clearing a major hurdle for the long-delayed variant. The final test flight took off from and landed at Boeing Field in Seattle, where crews evaluated whether the lavatory smoke detector and cabin speaker system were clearly audible. According to Boeing, the MAX 10 test fleet completed 976 flights totaling more than 2,060 flight hours, along with about 1,040 hours of ground testing.

The test campaign covered the aircraft’s main landing gear, braking performance on wet runways and during maximum-energy stops, as well as changes to the engine anti-ice system and angle-of-attack sensors. Three aircraft took part in the MAX 10 flight-test effort, and Boeing plans to remove test equipment and convert them to customer configurations ahead of delivery.

Chris Payne, Vice President and General Manager of Boeing’s 737 development programs, said reaching the milestone is a testament to the commitment and dedication of the entire team and an important step on the journey forward. Boeing still must finish remaining safety and design reviews and submit final documents to the Federal Aviation Administration.

The third development assurance review is complete while the fourth is 60% finished, and system safety assessments are 32% complete. Boeing continues to target MAX 10 certification in 2026 followed by first customer deliveries in 2027. During the second-quarter 2026 earnings call, President and CEO Kelly Ortberg confirmed certification work on both variants is entering its final stages and deliveries remain on track for 2027.

The smaller MAX 7 has also completed certification flight testing, with documentation roughly 95% finished. Southwest Airlines holds 256 firm orders for the MAX 7 and United Airlines is the largest MAX 10 customer with 167 aircraft on order.
